title: Japan
dek: Three and a half weeks chasing koyo from Kyushu to Hokkaido to Tohoku, four friends' way — Fukuoka's food scene and a real Hokkaido hiking stretch for everyone, then a Sendai finish for the two of you staying on for the Pokémon GO Wild Area weekend.

cover.alt: Naruko Gorge in full autumn color — red, orange, and yellow foliage lining the canyon walls

verified: Checked 2026-08-14 — a canonical/verified backbone and an independent local/authentic pass reconciled into one guide, then read end to end by a fresh reviewer who corrected ten findings and re-audited a sample of citations against the pages they cite. Confirmed against primary sources: Pokémon GO Wild Area Sendai (Nov 6–8, 2026 — pokemongo.com; venue + ticket sales still unannounced), US visa-free entry (90 days — mofa.go.jp), Japan's Nov 1, 2026 tax-free system cutover (mlit.go.jp), the Zao Ropeway's actual Apr 1–Dec 10 operating season and its ¥4,400 adult round-trip fare (zaoropeway.co.jp — correcting, respectively, an unsourced "typically closes in November" assumption and a ≈¥3,000 fare credited to a page that carries no fare, both carried over from an earlier pass on this same trip), JR Kyushu/JR East–South Hokkaido rail-pass pricing, every restaurant/shop/trail address in the Food & dining, Shopping, Nature and Sights tabs, and the local pass's crowd/timing and novel-alternative finds (Ofukazawa Promenade, Otaru's North Canal, Mt. Moiwa's night-view crowd window, Yamadera's opening time, Tetarazu Kaihin Park, Akaiwa no Ma, the Nagahama yatai district, Tanyaki Ichiryu Honten, gop no Anagura, TICRO MARKET). ⚠ Re-check before travel: Wild Area Sendai's exact venue and ticket sale date (unannounced); the JMC's first 2026 koyo forecast (publishes ~mid-Sept 2026 — every foliage date here is a multi-year average); the US State Dept advisory level (its page is bot-gated against automated fetches — needs a live browser check, not yet done); the Zao/Sendai accommodation split for the 2 travelers continuing past Nov 2 (open traveler question); your actual departure airport (unconfirmed — no globe route drawn until set).

entry.visa: Visa-free for tourism, stays up to 90 days. Japan's planned digital pre-arrival system ("JESTA") isn't targeted to launch until FY2028, so nothing new applies for this trip; the optional Visit Japan Web pre-registration remains optional, not mandatory.
entry.passportValidity: Japan's own rule only requires validity through your date of departure; the conventional 6-months-remaining buffer is still what most airlines check at boarding, so plan to that stricter standard.
entry.note: Assumes a US passport for all 4 travelers, per intake — on another passport, check your own country's requirement. mofa.go.jp blocks direct automated fetches (bot-protection); read via a mirror this pass — worth a quick manual re-check before booking.
